_meta.note: The restore path, and the fixture the routing read-back rests on. session/set_mode was accepted on a LIVE session -- including for the auto-approving mode -- each acknowledged by a current_mode_update. A later session/load for that id then returns the mode the session was LEFT in rather than the mode the child's environment asks for, which is why Crew reads the mode back on the load path as well as on session/new: a session restored after any actor moved it would otherwise come back permissive. session/resume is the method this harness does not serve (-32601), the inverse of a harness that serves resume without load. Reductions: ids replaced with fixed synthetic values; catalog cut as in the handshake file; the remaining set_mode acknowledgement and the available_commands_update frames dropped.
